messages.author: 06ad081d889cd1e0
messages.subject: Example of reactive calls
parts:
Hi,
         I am trying to find examples of a Java call that pushes data to a shiny UI graph. I have an API that can get data from a JVM. I want to push this to the UI using a R/Java integration call.

This will create a dashboard with graphs and data that are dynamically updated. Are there such applications being developed using shiny ?

Thanks,
Mohan

messages.author: f6533829f572ad74
messages.subject: Re: Example of reactive calls
parts:
well i am to build one dashboard with shiny, but in my case i am getting the data through an API call which is written in python and then saving the data in csv format. Then I'm using R to plot data out of collected data. so technically the python script is integrated with R.
may be you can also take the same approach. Doing any java call for data or plotting is not known to me.

messages.subject: Re: Example of reactive calls
parts:
There is static log analysis also like you mentioned. But the crux is the rJava/JRI integration. If there is no such example then Netflix's reactive model might serve as one. Calls can be made using rJava back to shiny.

I was thinking that this model is already in vogue because shiny needs data to plot graphs dynamically and statically. But I may be mistaken.

Thanks,
Mohan
